Root ruling, 2026-08-27, before execution freeze:
Approve creating /tmp and /home/user only as required infrastructure; do not create unused /fixture/tmp. Preserve shopt recipe and expected bytes unchanged. Record this explicit setup-only correction to the preparation plan in the execution delta. Do not alter historical prepared artifacts. Continue actual bounded execution promptly after this documented pre-freeze setup correction. No new target names or product edits.

2. Record actual supported effective settings, not a zero-redirect claim where the public limit requires positive values.
3. Apply already-approved /tmp and /home/user infrastructure, omit unused /fixture/tmp. Preserve original shopt script and expected bytes; record separate setup delta.
4. Approve exactly TWO added pre-corrected-freeze reachability diagnostics: mapfile -t rows < rows.txt and readarray -t rows < rows.txt, same files. No positive coverage credit and no new targets. New corrected corpus remains 61 primary +7 diagnostics per engine, 136 attempts; initial 61+5/132 retained separately. Parser rejection before dispatch is not observed missing-handler execution.

Reuse existing source snapshot/hash 30f5cfb47f69af0aeb4460fa901904d0b70f4ca8594013f70aa308dafb379732, never moving live source. Independent measured reviewer is active, reads coverage-execution only, owns coverage-review/measured. It will examine this correction and wait for final closed-author release before independent replay. Route any further genuine harness/config issue explicitly; do not force-green. Reviewer reports initial js-exec raw phases reached after-census/cleanup in about180ms, with later retained-process/capture timeout. Preserve raw evidence and distinguish guest outcome from capture/cleanup timeout; do not count this as guest arithmetic runtime failure absent evidence.

Preserve initial audit failure; corrected realpath+byte validation must show whether these are aliases, not mislabel them as live-source escapes. This is an attribution requirement, not permission to change an already-frozen attempt or rerun extra cases.

ROOT reporting ruling, 2026-08-27; no source/corpus/expected-byte changes or extra author calls.
Read corrected author and independent reviewer findings. Preserve all raw strict labels/bytes, supplement classifications transparently:
- tree: unchanged strict display predicate fails (ASCII vs Unicode), but correct hierarchy/counts are semantic functionality. Treat this as display-profile/over-specific predicate difference, not absent tree or broadly partial utility. Do not re-freeze or retarget expected bytes. Separate from actual compopt/exec functional gaps.
- js-exec: captured status0/stdout42-newline/empty stderr and completed VFS census prove guest execution here; remaining process cleanup required SIGTERM after grace. Keep lifecycle failure explicit and raw timeout label immutable. Not missing/disabled/startup failure/120s guest timeout; removing inherited trace did not establish cause. Root acknowledges135 normal children plus1 exceptional cleanup, allclosed, not136 normal. Independent replay may reproduce the same bounded cleanup behavior, no forced-normal exit/private worker patch/defense disable.
- comparisonPolicy.namespace obsolete fixture/tmp wording: disclose frozen prose mismatch; actual setup omitted it per ruling. Do not rewrite frozen artifact.
- baseline binary control differs in actual VFS bytes as well as terminal output, so not solely terminal-string boundary. Preserve exact bytes. No broad parity/superiority conclusion from this narrow control.
Author finish report/validation and exact owned commit, close normally. Reviewer independently assess same artifacts and repeat only declared136 after finalclosed-author release. SGID/env normative qualifiers remain mandatory. All54 ours name dispatch gaps must distinguish primary47 observed missing from7 reached diagnostics; prerequisite parser failures alone are not dispatch evidence. Missing optional CLI names do not disprove nominal SafeJS companion API or claim runtime was installed.

AUTHORITATIVE USER UPDATE, committed primary normative evidence1f2aa30:

Environment ordering is unspecified by POSIX. The recorded GNU9.7 environment-order capture is Darwin/libSystem, NOT Linux. Preserve exact observations and runtime/profile qualifiers; do not label ordering-only differences POSIX failures or extrapolate to Linux.
Continue existing bounded breadth audit without product edits. Classify tested behavior versus the explicit pinned just-bash3.4.2/ours fixtures and any declared selected profile, not universal POSIX/GNU/Bash claims. Final audit/review reporting must include these qualifications wherever SGID/environment observations are mentioned. No new normative or permission investigation is requested.
